# PrairieCare

> PrairieCare is a comprehensive psychiatric and mental healthcare provider serving children, teens, and adults across Minnesota with evidence-based treatment programs.

PrairieCare operates multiple locations throughout Minnesota including the Twin Cities, Rochester, and Mankato regions. The organization specializes in both inpatient and outpatient psychiatric services with a focus on evidence-based care approaches.
